tell: A BTK inhibitor whose active metabolite, ACP-5862, reaches roughly 2- to 3-fold the parent drug's exposure.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is 25%, and a high-fat meal leaves overall exposure unchanged but lowers peak levels by 54%. It is 97.5% bound to plasma protein and mainly metabolized by CYP3A enzymes.
Supplied as a maleate salt, with an active moiety of molecular weight 465.5. It is a white to pale brown powder with pH-dependent solubility.
Approved under an NDA as 100 mg tablets, taken twice daily.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. The most common Grade 3 or 4 abnormalities are a falling neutrophil count and rising uric acid, at 32% and 27%.
Mantle cell lymphoma, untreated (with bendamustine and rituximab) or after at least one prior therapy, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma.
A covalent inhibitor of Bruton tyrosine kinase, bonding a cysteine in its active site and so blocking B-cell receptor signaling.
The generic name begins with A and has thirteen letters.
